What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound — and because silicone shrinks differently from nitrile and FKM, it needs its own tool. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes — and if the seal you are replacing is silicone, tell us how long it lasted. A short life on a running shaft usually means the compound was chosen for temperature without checking the speed. We would rather quote you FKM than sell you the same failure twice.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP — but a drawing is often unnecessary. Shaft diameter, housing bore, width, type A or AS, plus the shaft speed, the duty cycle and both temperatures is a complete specification for this compound.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, and post-cure is recorded on the batch record — it is what makes the temperature rating real. We do not hold food-contact or pharmaceutical approvals.
